correctness.rationale: Independent-cycle decomposition gives E[min(τ,E_r)]=q/r and T_μ=(q+...+q^(μ+1))/r for q=1-e^-z and z=a sqrt(r/D). Differentiating yields derivative sign f(q)E_(μ+1)(q)-2. Index-mean E_n increases in n and q, while f decreases. For n=21 the low/high q analytic estimates and the exact 80-subinterval rational bound over [1/2,19/20] prove globally negative derivative; the independent exact-rational check reproduced 159 nodes and 80 leaves. At n=22, seven-term atanh lower bound for log7 and a rational weighted-index inequality prove positive derivative at q=6/7, propagating to higher n; endpoint signs are negative. The strict analyticity argument yields at least one minimum and later maximum, not unique extrema. Important primary-reference correction: the frozen text says Eq 5.37 of Bressloff for finite-budget mean, whereas full paper Eq 5.38 is finite-budget and Eq 5.37 unbounded-reset; the formula and proof itself are correct.
